This archive records a previous **Bachata Congress** ticket tier for transparency. Milano Sensual Congress is a limited-capacity **Bachata Event** with prices released in stages: the €125 Full Pass tier shown here was valid through July 31, 2026 and has now ended.

### What Was Included in the €125 Ticket Tier?

The [Full Pass](https://milanosensualcongress.com/tickets) was available for **€125** until **July 31 at midnight**. It included the core congress experience: workshops, parties, shows and social dancing. The active ticket page now shows the current €130 tier through September 15.

The [Masterclass upgrade](https://milanosensualcongress.com/masterclass) is now **€65**. This upgrade requires a valid Full Pass and adds focused high-level training with selected international artists. No further Masterclass price increases are planned.

### How the July 31 Price Deadline Worked

July 31 at midnight was the confirmed deadline for this Full Pass tier. After that date, the pass moved into the next tier as the congress came closer and availability became tighter.

This is important because many dancers wait for the final lineup, the travel plan or the friend group confirmation. That is understandable, but for a limited **Bachata Workshop** and party weekend, the best ticket price is usually available before the last wave of demand arrives.
